reason: Gold supply, demand and prices inform realized selling prices and mine economics.
Gold-market and royalty research informs metal-price exposure and royalty or streaming receipts.
Bitcoin price, network difficulty, hashprice and power costs inform mining revenue and margins.
Bitcoin-market and treasury models inform asset value, financing and dilution; mining costs are not company operating costs.
Exchange volumes, clearing, competition and pricing research inform transaction and market-data revenue.
Power availability, interconnection and demand research informs site capacity, energy costs or contracted power revenue.
Oil and gas prices, volumes and supply-demand research inform royalty receipts.
